title: Production analytics
summary: Manufacturing analytics SaaS with two groups of users: managers working through production data, and operators logging what happens on the shop floor.

meta.label: Platforms
meta.value: Web on desktop and mobile, shop-floor tablet

meta.label: Scope
meta.value: Product UX and UI, rebrand, illustration, motion

sections.heading: Evocon
body: Evocon is a startup whose software tracks factory production, so manufacturers can waste less time and material. I was its in-house designer and worked on both the product and the brand.

sections.heading: Two users, opposite needs
body: Managers work through large volumes of data in tables and charts, on PC and mobile. Operators stand at the line and need to report what's happening in as few taps as possible.
Evocon also wanted to teach its customers the ideas behind the numbers, like OEE or the difference between slow speed and a microstop.

sections.heading: Operator tablet app
body: The tablet sits next to the line. Its bottom bar has a button for each event an operator reports, like downtime, a product changeover or scrap. Station states are color-coded, so a stop or slowdown stands out.

sections.heading: Manager dashboards
body: Everything operators log feeds the manager dashboards. They show the live state of every line and where production loses time. The improvement view tracks whether a change, like a shorter machine reset, holds up over the following weeks.

sections.heading: Rebrand
body: I led Evocon's rebrand together with a UX designer and researcher. The new brand is built on illustration and motion, which the site uses to explain production concepts. Drag the slider to compare the old and new site.

sections.heading: Mascot and icons
body: Evocon's mascot also appears in the operator view, where it reacts to what's happening on the line. I animated its states and idle loops in After Effects. Product icons animate on hover, or on press on tablets. I exported both with Lottie so the web app could play them.

media.alt: Animated product icons for production, operators, speed comments and scrap
media.caption: Animated icons

sections.heading: Content marketing
body: For content marketing, I made article illustrations and short animations about how a production line runs and where Evocon helps a factory improve.
